role: First-class graph artifacts for inner monologue reasoning sessions (CANON A.19).
detail: Defines three node types (ReasoningEpisode, ReasoningStep, ReasoningConclusion) and four edge types (HAS_REASONING_STEP, HAS_CONCLUSION, TRIGGERED_BY, REFERENCES) for recording problem-solving traces as persistent graph artifacts. ReasoningEpisode is the top-level container (trigger, trigger_type, step_count, conclusion_reached, termination_reason, session_id). ReasoningStep records individual reasoning steps with query_type, query_subject, query_result_summary, confidence_delta, inner_speech (PRIVATE register), and execution_time_ms. ReasoningConclusion captures final result with conclusion_text (inner register), external_text (outer register via PT-11), confidence, grounded, referenced_node_count, reasoning_path_summary. All nodes use SchemaLevel.INSTANCE and Provenance.INFERENCE. Node ID formats: episode:{uuid}, rstep:{uuid}, rconc:{uuid}. Edge properties include step_number (HAS_REASONING_STEP) and reference_type (REFERENCES).
gotchas: No stubs or TODOs. register_separation is documented (A.19.2) but enforcement is delegated to InnerMonologueExecutor and PT-11/PT-12 translation modules. Confidence clamped to [0.0,1.0] in _inference_provenance. Edge confidence defaults to 1.0 (structural). inner_speech marked PRIVATE but actual access control is external (should be enforced by consumers).
